mechanism: Accumulation/Distribution cumulative money-flow line: money-flow multiplier=((close-low)-(high-close))/(high-low), MFV=multiplier*volume, AD=prior AD+MFV. Sense rising vs declining AD by comparing current AD to previous AD each tick.
data_needed: OHLC + tick or real volume; iAD handle; current and previous AD buffer values.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; generic 19-day OHLC+volume worked example; VOLUME_TICK or VOLUME_REAL.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a running money-into/out-of-instrument liquidity sensor (Chaikin AD) with an explicit rise/decline state, complementary to raw volume bars.
quote: the AD line is the running total for the Money Flow Volume of each period

mechanism: Flag AD current as strong if AD[0] > max(AD[1..10]) and weak if AD[0] < min(AD[1..10])—extremal breakout of the cumulative money-flow line vs its recent window.
data_needed: AD series of length ≥11; ArrayMaximum/ArrayMinimum over prior 10 AD values.
why_new_for_mis: Turns AD into a local money-flow intensity sensor (break of 10-bar AD range), not just sign of slope.
quote: Current AD > Maximum value of the previous 10 AD values --> the AD current value is strong

mechanism: On higher highs: if AD also rises → strong up-move confirmation; if AD falls while high rises → bearish divergence (money flow fails to confirm). Symmetric on lower lows for strong down vs bullish divergence.
data_needed: Current/previous AD; current/previous high (or low); CopyRates for highs/lows.
why_new_for_mis: Volume-flow vs price-extreme divergence as a regime-change / reversal-warning sensor for MIS.
quote: The current AD < the previous AD and the current high > the previous high --> Bearish divergence

mechanism: Money Flow Index from typical price TP=(H+L+C)/3, raw MF=volume*TP, signed by TP up/down, 14-period +MF/−MF ratio → MFI=100−100/(1+ratio). Sense oversold MFI≤20 and overbought MFI≥80; also uptrend band MFI in [50,70] and downtrend band [30,50].
data_needed: OHLC + VOLUME_TICK/REAL; iMFI(period=24 in code, classic calc uses 14); MFI buffer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; generic OHLC+volume table; tick or real volume.
why_new_for_mis: Volume-weighted RSI-like buying/selling-pressure sensor with explicit OB/OS and trend-band regimes for MIS liquidity sensing.
quote: It is a volume-based indicator but it uses the price and volume in its calculation to measure the buying and selling pressure

mechanism: Compare consecutive MFI and highs: MFI↑ and high↑ → strong up; MFI↓ while high↑ → bearish divergence. Symmetric on lows for strong down vs bullish divergence.
data_needed: Current/previous MFI; current/previous high or low.
why_new_for_mis: Pairs money-flow oscillator with price extremes as a confirmation/divergence change sensor.
quote: Current MFI < previous MFI and current high > previous high --> bearish divergence

mechanism: Compare current Volumes bar to average of prior five Volumes: above AVG → strong volume; below → weak. Forex Volumes = count of price changes (tick); stocks = shares*price.
data_needed: iVolumes(VOLUME_TICK or REAL); current + 5 prior volume buffer values; 5-bar average.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; Forex tick-volume vs stock traded-volume distinction emphasized.
why_new_for_mis: Simple relative-volume liquidity intensity sensor (current vs short rolling average) usable on tick or real volume.

mechanism: During up moves: higher high AND rising volume → buy/confirm; higher high with falling volume → no confirm. During down moves: lower low AND rising volume → short confirm; lower low with falling volume → no confirm. Also MA crossover gated by rising volume.
data_needed: Current/previous high or low; current/previous volume; optional short/long SMA (10/24).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; MA periods 10 and 24 in coded example.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit price-extreme × volume co-movement sensor for trend-strength vs exhaustion—core MIS liquidity confirmation.
quote: Current high > previous high && current volume > previous volume --> Buy signal during uptrend

mechanism: Ichimoku Kumo regime: close > Senkou Span A and close > Senkou Span B → uptrend; close < both spans → downtrend. Spans plotted 26 periods ahead; Tenkan=(9H+9L)/2, Kijun=(26H+26L)/2, Span B=(52H+52L)/2.
data_needed: CiIchimoku or equivalent; close; SenkouSpanA(-26), SenkouSpanB(-26); periods 9/26/52.
why_new_for_mis: Multi-component cloud position as a durable trend-regime sensor (price relative to forward-shifted equilibrium bands).
quote: Closing price > Senkou Span B and closing price > Senkou Span A --> Uptrend

mechanism: Trend-strength sensor: current Senkou Span A > previous Span A and current Span A > Span B → strong uptrend; Span A falling and below Span B → strong downtrend.
data_needed: Current and prior Senkou Span A; Senkou Span B.
why_new_for_mis: Separates regime direction (cloud) from regime strength (Span A slope vs Span B)—useful MIS strength overlay.
quote: Current Senkou Span A > previous Senkou Span A and current Senkou Span A > Senkou Span B --> the uptrend is strong

mechanism: Standard Deviation of close vs SMA: dispersion around mean; sqrt of average squared deviations. High-vol if current StdDev > average of prior 5 StdDev values; low-vol if below. Optional gate: rising StdDev (or high vs AVG) plus Ask/Bid vs MA for directional trades only in elevated vol.
data_needed: iStdDev(20, MODE_SMA, PRICE_CLOSE); current + 5 prior StdDev; optional iMA(10).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; worked close-price example; StdDev period 20, MA 10 in strategies.
why_new_for_mis: Classic statistical volatility sensor with an explicit high/low regime vs its own short average—direct MIS volatility input.
quote: The Standard deviation indicator measures the volatility.

mechanism: Chaikin Oscillator = 3-EMA(ADL) − 10-EMA(ADL), where ADL accumulates money-flow volume. Zero-line cross: Chaikin > 0 → buy/accumulation momentum; < 0 → sell/distribution. Also sense rising vs declining Chaikin slope.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; fast 3 / slow 10 EMA of ADL; tick or real volume.
why_new_for_mis: MACD-of-ADL momentum sensor on money flow—liquidity acceleration around zero for MIS.
quote: It measures the momentum of the accumulation distribution line using the moving average convergence divergence (MACD) formula

mechanism: Higher high with rising Chaikin → strong up confirm; higher high with falling Chaikin → bearish divergence. Lower low with falling Chaikin → strong down; lower low with rising Chaikin → bullish divergence.
data_needed: Current/previous high or low; current/previous Chaikin.
why_new_for_mis: ADL-momentum vs price-extreme divergence as a change/reversal warning layered on money-flow.
quote: The current high > the previous high and the current Chaikin < the previous Chaikin --> Bearish divergence

mechanism: Force Index 1-period=(close−prior close)*volume; 13-period = EMA of 1-period FI. FI>0 → bullish force regime; FI<0 → bearish. Divergences: higher high with rising FI = strong up; higher high with falling FI = bearish divergence (symmetric on lows). Signals: close>EMA and FI crosses up through zero → buy; close<EMA and FI crosses down → sell.
data_needed: iForce(13,MODE_EMA,VOLUME_TICK); close; optional EMA(50); highs/lows for divergence.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; FI period 13 (trend-id uses 100); EMA 50 in signal strategy.
why_new_for_mis: Elder price×volume force oscillator gives MIS a signed liquidity-power regime and zero-cross change cue.
quote: Force Index of 1-period = (Close of 1-period  - Close of previous period) * Volume

mechanism: VIDYA = Price*F*|CMO| + VIDYA_prev*(1−F*|CMO|), F=2/(EMA_period+1), CMO=(UpSum−DnSum)/(UpSum+DnSum). Volatility (via CMO) dynamically widens/tightens EMA smoothing. Regime: close>VIDYA → uptrend/bullish control; close<VIDYA → downtrend. Dual VIDYA(9,12) vs VIDYA(20,50) crossover as fast/slow adaptive trend sensor.
data_needed: iVIDyA(cmo_period, ema_period, shift, PRICE_CLOSE); close; optional second VIDYA handle.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; defaults CMO 9 / EMA 12; dual settings (9,12) and (20,50).
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-adaptive moving average (CMO-scaled) as a regime filter that speeds up in volatile markets and slows in quiet ones—distinct from fixed-period MAs.
quote: it will be dynamically adjusted based on relative price volatility. The volatility is measured by the Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO)

mechanism: DeMarker DeM=SMA(DeMax,N)/(SMA(DeMax,N)+SMA(DeMin,N)) with DeMax=max(High_i−High_{i−1},0), DeMin=max(Low_{i−1}−Low_i,0). Oscillates 0–1: ≥0.70 overbought, ≤0.30 oversold. Strength: current DeM vs average of prior 5 DeM. Divergence: higher high with lower DeM → bearish; lower low with higher DeM → bullish.
data_needed: iDeMarker(14); current + prior DeM; highs/lows for divergence; 5-bar DeM average.
why_new_for_mis: Demand oscillator comparing consecutive highs/lows (not close-in-range like Stochastic/WPR)—alternate exhaustion and divergence sensor for MIS.
quote: This technical indicator measures the demand for the instrument and evaluates the directional trend of the market by comparing the current maximum and minimum prices to the previous prices

mechanism: Bear's Power = Low − EMA(period); Bull's Power = High − EMA(period) (Elder). Oscillators around zero measure bearishness/bullishness (supply/demand pressure). Sense rising/declining power; strong move vs divergence vs price lows/highs; combine with close vs EMA and zero-line for sided pressure regimes. Pair both for two-sided demand/supply sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; period 13 default in both companion articles (11297 Bears, 11327 Bulls).
why_new_for_mis: Signed high−EMA / low−EMA oscillators give MIS explicit bull-side and bear-side pressure sensors (and their divergences), beyond unsigned volume.
